kind: source-derived contract fixtures; illustrative IDs/times, not executed results

routing.behavior: chi /api/projects registers GET / and POST / to ListProjects/CreateProject. Enclosing Auth and RefreshCloudFrontCookies, then RequireWorkspaceMember; neither route has RequireHumanActor nor owner/admin restriction. Global request ID, client metadata, logger, recovery, plugin host boundary, CSP and CORS also apply.

access.behavior: Auth accepts supported bearer identities or workpal_auth cookie; cookie mutations require CSRF. Missing authorization is 401 {error: missing authorization}; failed CSRF is 403 {error: CSRF validation failed}; invalid token is 401 {error: invalid token}. Auth uses http.Error, so these JSON-looking bodies have text/plain content type and newline. Do not trust caller identity headers.

Workspace middleware selector priority: task-token bound workspace, workspace_slug query, X-Workspace-Slug, workspace_id query, X-Workspace-ID. This differs from handler fallback priority; use injected context on these routes. Missing selector 400; unknown slug or absent membership 404 workspace not found; malformed UUID 400 invalid workspace_id; absent/invalid user 401 user not authenticated. No role gate.

List removes hidden private projects before filters, stats, sorting and paging. Human workspace owner/admin receives no private visibility bypass. Agent visibility derives from task run principals and agent owner; missing attribution fails closed. Access lookup failure returns 500 failed to resolve project access (query cancellation may terminate earlier).

rules.behavior: q is trimmed case-insensitive title substring. status, priority and lead accept repeated/comma-separated values, OR within each field and AND across fields. lead accepts none, member:<uuid>, agent:<uuid>; missing either lead component counts as none. Archived excluded by default; include_archived only literal true includes them; archived=only overrides it; other nonempty archived values reject.

Default sort created_at descending. Sort options/default direction: name asc, priority desc, status asc, progress desc, start_date asc, due_date asc, created_at desc, last_activity_at desc. direction asc/desc overrides. Priority rank none low medium high urgent; status planned in_progress paused completed cancelled. Progress done/total, zero issues=-1. Undated last in both directions; tie lowercase title then id.

No limit returns all matches; explicit limit integer 1..200; offset integer >=0 default 0. total counts all visible filtered matches before pagination; has_more = offset + returned length < total. Empty/beyond-end page is [] not null.

Issue count includes all project issues in workspace; done count uses terminal category keys (fallback done,cancelled); activity=max(project.updated_at, issue.updated_at, issue.last_activity_at). Resource count grouped by project. Stats/count query failures are swallowed, leaving zero counts/project activity.

fixtures.precondition: Authenticated workspace member; exactly one visible unarchived Roadmap project with no issues/resources
Authenticated and workspace-scoped; fewer than 100 matches

rules.behavior: JSON decoder accepts unknown fields and only decodes first value. title required only != empty string (whitespace accepted). Missing/null/empty status defaults planned and priority none. Allowed statuses planned,in_progress,paused,completed,cancelled; priorities urgent,high,medium,low,none. Wrong JSON field types/malformed input ->400 invalid request body.

description/icon omitted or null ->SQL NULL, empty string retained. lead_type/lead_id nullable independently; lead_id when supplied must parse UUID; lead_type constrained member/agent by DB. Dates omitted/null/empty ->NULL; otherwise calendar YYYY-MM-DD. No start-before-due validation here. workflow_id omitted/null/empty ->NULL; supplied workflow must exist in workspace, default workflow normalized NULL. creator resolved from request actor; response creator is that actor, while events use member/userID.

visibility omitted/null/empty/workspace ->workspace. member_ids ignored on workspace-visible create. private requires non-agent actor, UUID member IDs deduplicated; creator and member lead automatically included; all must be workspace members. No owner/admin requirement.

resources omitted/null/[] means none. Every resource is validated before transaction. Known types github_repo (trim URL, valid http(s)/ssh git URL, optional trimmed default_branch_hint/ref with git-ref validation) and local_directory (absolute local_path, nonempty trimmed daemon_id, optional trimmed label, execution_mode empty/in_place/worktree). Unknown type or missing ref is 400. One local directory per daemon in batch. Worktree requires newest-seen runtime advertised capability; otherwise 422 daemon_version_unsupported with error,current_version,min_version,daemon_id; runtime query failure 500. Row label trimmed/blank->NULL; position defaults batch index. Note validation trims resource_type in a range copy but INSERT uses original string.

Simple path (no resources and not private): one INSERT, no explicit transaction, 201 metadata only. Otherwise Begin, INSERT project, add/verify private members, set visibility, INSERT all resources, Commit; deferred Rollback covers failures. Transactional response adds resources array (including [] for private-only create). Resource uniqueness violation ->409; other resource write ->500.

After successful insert/commit, CreateProject calls h.publish(project:created,workspaceID,member,userID,{project:metadata}); then one project_resource:created per resource with {resource,project_id}. publish calls Bus.Publish(events.Event). No durable outbox/dispatch acknowledgement in this function; no event on rolled-back transaction. GET emits none.

sqlite_mapping.behavior: project: text UUID primary key generated by service; workspace_id required ->workspace.id cascade; title required; nullable description/icon/lead_type/lead_id; constrained status/priority; timestamps required. Extend with nullable calendar start_date/due_date, workflow_id, creator_type/id, archive timestamp/actor; visibility required default workspace. lead/creator/workflow are soft IDs, do not invent FK constraints.

workspace(id,slug) and member(workspace_id,user_id,role) support scope and membership. project_member(workspace_id,project_id,user_id,added_by,created_at), PK(project_id,user_id), no Go foreign keys; insert only users selected from member, duplicate ignored. Preserve tenant consistency explicitly.

project_resource: id PK, required project_id FK cascade and workspace_id FK cascade, resource_type, structured resource_ref, nullable label/created_by, position default0, created_at; unique(project_id,resource_type,resource_ref). SQLite JSON equality must reproduce normalized JSONB structural uniqueness, not raw JSON string ordering.

issue(workspace_id,project_id,status,updated_at,last_activity_at) supplies aggregates; project_id references project ON DELETE SET NULL. issue status catalog/workflow tables supply terminal keys and workflow existence. agent_task and agent owner_id supply private run principals; agent_runtime(workspace_id,daemon_id,metadata,last_seen_at) supports optional worktree resource gate. Translate UUID arrays/ANY, FILTER, GREATEST, JSONB, generated UUID/now to SQLite equivalents; use short atomic writes for private/resource path.
